links.title: Visa Application Instructions of the People's Republic of China

docs.text: Passport and completed online visa application form with photo
Proof of legal stay or residence in the country of application (if applicable)
Q1: invitation letter from the Chinese citizen or foreign permanent resident family member
Q1: copy of inviter's Chinese ID card or passport and permanent residence permit
Q1: original and copy of proof of family relationship (marriage/birth certificate)
S1: invitation letter from the foreign family member residing in China
S1: copies of inviter's passport and residence permit
S1: original and copy of proof of kinship (spouse, parent, child under 18, parent-in-law)
Q1/S1 holders apply for a residence permit within 30 days of entry

links.title: Visa Application Instructions of the People's Republic of China

docs.text: Passport and completed online visa application form with photo
Notice for the Work Permit for Foreigners issued by the human resources and social security authority, or
Registration Certificate of a foreign enterprise's resident representative office, or
Approval for commercial performances plus Certificate of Short-term Work for Foreigners, or
CNOOC invitation letter for offshore petroleum operations
R: certification materials showing high-level talent / urgently needed specialist status
Apply for a residence permit within 30 days of entry unless the visa is marked for a 30-day stay

Regional Visa-Free Entry Policies for Foreign Nationals

docs.text: Passport and completed online visa application form with photo
Proof of legal stay or residence in the country of application (if applicable)
Previous Chinese passport or Chinese visa (if any)
Itinerary records: round-trip flight bookings and hotel reservations, or
Invitation letter from a Chinese entity or individual with invitee, travel and inviter details

links.title: Visa Application Instructions of the People's Republic of China

docs.text: Passport and completed online visa application form with photo
Admission letter from the Chinese school or institution
X1: Confirmation Form for Study in China (JW201 or JW202)
X1 holders apply for a residence permit within 30 days of entry
X2: admission letter only (study up to 180 days)

links.title: Visa Application Instructions of the People's Republic of China

docs.text: Passport and completed online visa application form with photo
M: invitation documents from a Chinese trade partner (business documents or trade fair invitation)
F: invitation letter from a Chinese entity or individual for exchanges, visits or study tours
Invitation letter must state invitee details, purpose, dates, places, relationship, who pays, and inviter contact, seal and signature

links.title: Visa Application Instructions of the People's Republic of China

docs.text: Passport and completed online visa application form with photo
Q2: invitation letter from the relative who is a Chinese citizen or foreign permanent resident
Q2: copy of inviter's Chinese ID card or passport and permanent residence permit
S2: invitation letter from the family member working or studying in China
S2: copies of inviter's passport and residence permit, copy of kinship proof
Stay up to 180 days

links.title: Visa Application Instructions of the People's Republic of China

docs.text: C (crew): guarantee letter from the foreign transport company or invitation from a Chinese entity
D (permanent residence): Confirmation Form for Foreigner's Permanent Residence Status (original and copy)
G (transit): confirmed onward ticket with date and seat to the destination country or region
J1/J2 (journalists): visa notification letter from the MFA press department and official letter from the media organization
Passport and completed online visa application form with photo

entryRules.note: Ordinary passport holders; business, tourism, visiting relatives/friends, exchange visits or transit. Stay counted from 00:00 the day after entry. List compiled as of 2026-02-17.
240-hour visa-free transit only: ordinary passport plus onward ticket with confirmed seat to a third country/region; entry via designated ports and stay within permitted areas; work/study excluded.
